obligations.source_text: The complete outfit topology, neckline, both shoulders and sleeves, waist and closure or crotch and inseam region, legs, and hems must remain fully visible and readable in one vertical full-body frame.

bindings.upper_waist_continuity_phrase: the upper garment and waist remain one continuous unit, with the tailored bodice flowing uninterrupted across the torso
bindings.crotch_continuity_phrase: the same garment continues through a visible crotch, while waist shaping flows into the central rise
bindings.two_leg_phrase: a visible inseam separates two independent legs, and each trouser leg reads as its own moving branch
bindings.variant_length_phrase: full-length trouser legs define the selected jumpsuit, ending in two distinct ankle-level hems
bindings.dress_separates_confound_phrase: a dress hem cannot substitute for the two-leg split, and a matching top and trousers remain two garments and do not substitute
